newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street seen extending gains at open.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street seen extending gains at open.

text.p: Wall Street shares are expected to open higher on Wednesday, still basking after Federal Reserve Alan Greenspan delivered an upbeat report on the U.S. economy to Congress on Tuesday.

The stock market, which surged on Tuesday when the Fed chief's comments put fears of an imminent interest rate hike to rest, would extend gains and draw further fuel from solid corporate earnings reports, analysts said.
The blue-chip Dow Jones Industrial Average jumped 154.93 points, or 1.96 percent on Tuesday to close at a record 8,061.65. It was the Dow's fourth biggest points gain in history.
